name: royalty-erp
description: Music-label royalty ERP, iteration 1 (Believe master + B17 publishing)

scripts.dev:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.app.dev.yml up -d deps api web
scripts.dev:docker:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.app.dev.yml logs -f deps api web
scripts.dev:docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.app.dev.yml rm -sf deps api web
